headline: Ford Stock Jumps On Upgrade, Earnings Beat; Are Its EV Woes In The Rear View Mirror?
summary: Ford stock rose sharply on Wednesday morning after the Detroit automaker reported mixed second-quarter results and raised its full-year guidance, earnings a quick upgrade to buy from Citi. Shares of Ford were up around 5.5% in Wednesday's premarket trading, according to MarketSurge.
